**Get it on [Nexus Mods](https://www.nexusmods.com/startrekoutpostsunknown/mods/1)**, or download `LukasMods-STOU-DudeWheresMyBuggy-1.0.0.zip` below. It's the same archive as the one on Nexus, byte for byte: sha256 `dbc184eef8a5354d4f59da5f60d640aacb2ab87f591310c2b5d09a9f0840ec3f`.

Click a Cargo Buggy to see its whole route: each pickup and delivery stop in order, what it's moving, and which stop it's on. Display only: buggies drive as before.

Needs the Steam version of the game and BepInEx 6.0.0-be.790 (Unity IL2CPP, win-x64), the exact build it was tested with: [BepInEx's build site](https://builds.bepinex.dev/projects/bepinex_be), build #790. Extract this zip into your game folder, so the DLL lands in `BepInEx\plugins\DudeWheresMyBuggy`. Install and full details: [Dude, Where's My Buggy? guide](https://github.com/lukas-mods/Lukas-Mods/blob/main/guides/star-trek-outposts-unknown/dude-wheres-my-buggy.md).

> ⚠️ **Use at Your Own Risk.** Any mod can crash a game or damage a save, so back up your saves first: copy `userdata\<your Steam account number>\3469910\remote\` from your Steam folder somewhere safe.

## 1.0.0 - First Release

- Click a Cargo Buggy to see its whole route in its info panel, under VEHICLE INFO: every pickup and delivery stop in order.
- Each stop of a job shows the game's own Job Queue card for that job and, where the mod saw them, the resources and amounts moved there.
- The stop it's on is amber; finished stops still on the route are dimmed.
- The route updates while the panel is open, and long routes scroll.
- Display only: buggies drive and haul as before.
